selection_policy: No family, head, hyperparameter, seed, group or threshold selection after fitting or assessment. Development is descriptive only.
fit_method: TRAIN-only population standardization and ordinary least squares with intercept; partial pivot floor 1e-12; five parameters per axis/family; no regularization or search.

prior_exposure.policy: Exclude every b numerator in all original splits, independently regenerated from the frozen recipe; reserve b globally across all new seeds/splits. Original formulas/results are already known.

preflight_exposure.reason: An engineering overlap test generated these candidate raw coordinates before sealing; no heads were fitted and no scores observed. Exclude all their b numerators. New seeds and equal per-arm counts were chosen before scientific admission solely to fit the remaining coordinate reservation capacity.

engineering_exposure.policy: Scientific admission additionally excludes all b values from both engineering recipes and native selftest. Engineering always uses the fixed original-and-candidate exclusions, so repeated preflights cannot shift the reservation boundary.

synthetic_data_license: Project-authored fixed synthetic maps and generator; repository MIT license; no imported dataset, trained encoder or external service.
